issue_context.title: Make HubConnection more testable
comments: API review - Let's make all of these APIs `virtual`. The names are somewhat unfortunate, but since they're already a public, we can't change them.

review_comments: I think this is to much ceremony for what we're trying to achieve. This is about testability, not about being able to put custom code into our logging scopes. If you want to create an outer scope for your override, you can still do that.
